metadata.name: THMD-Guru OWASP Top 10, CWE, CVSS v3.1 & WSTG Verification Knowledge Base
metadata.maintainer: THMD-Guru Global Tech Academy — Cyber-AI Research Committee

entries.name: SQL Injection (SQLi)
tp_indicators: You have an error in your SQL syntax
authentication bypass returning valid JWT token
fp_exclusion_rules: Generic HTTP 500 Internal Server Error caused by JSON/integer type parsing without SQL driver trace
Static error page returning fixed template string regardless of single/double quote balance
entries.remediation: Use parameterized queries (Prepared Statements) or bound ORM parameters; never concatenate user input into SQL strings.

entries.name: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) / Broken Object Level Authorization
tp_indicators: HTTP 200 OK with another user's private BasketId, UserId, or Order record
Cross-tenant JSON object returned when incrementing resource ID
fp_exclusion_rules: Public catalog or product review endpoint intended for unauthenticated read access
entries.remediation: Enforce server-side object ownership checks comparing session user_id against resource owner_id on every controller route.

entries.name: Cross-Site Scripting (Reflected / DOM XSS)
tp_indicators: Unescaped
Direct DOM sink execution via innerHTML or bypassSecurityTrustHtml
fp_exclusion_rules: Payload reflected with HTML entity encoding (<script> or ")
Payload reflected inside application/json response with Content-Type: application/json and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
entries.remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding and strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers.

entries.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
tp_indicators: Internal loopback 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254 metadata, or internal subnet 172.28.x.x response content returned to client
fp_exclusion_rules: Client-side redirect URL validation where server does not perform outbound fetch
entries.remediation: Validate and allowlist outbound URL schemes and domains; block RFC1918, loopback, and link-local IP ranges.

entries.name: Weak Authentication / JWT Signature Verification Bypass
tp_indicators: alg:none JWT token accepted by server
Default administrator credentials accepted without rate limiting
entries.remediation: Enforce strong asymmetric JWT verification (RS256/EdDSA), reject 'none' algorithm, and enforce MFA/rate-limiting.

entries.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information (.bak / FTP / Prometheus / Stack Trace)
tp_indicators: Exposed /ftp/acquisitions.md, package.json.bak, .env, or SQLite database dump downloadable with HTTP 200
fp_exclusion_rules: Standard HTML/JS build comment or license header without secrets or internal paths
Custom 404 SPA fallback page returning index.html with HTTP 200 for non-existent backup filenames
entries.remediation: Disable directory listing, block access to backup/dotfiles at Nginx WAF, and disable verbose stack traces in production.

entries.name: Missing Security Headers (CSP / X-Frame-Options / HSTS)
tp_indicators: Interactive HTML state-changing page missing Content-Security-Policy and X-Frame-Options
fp_exclusion_rules: Static image/font asset (.png, .woff2, .ico) missing X-Frame-Options or CSP header
entries.remediation: Configure security headers globally on the Reverse Proxy / WAF for HTML document responses.
